name: Move Shopify Data to Azure Synapse via GraphQL
steps:
**Shopify to Azure Synapse**

1.  From the DataSources section select Shopify as the data source.
2.  Select your added Azure Synapse data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your Shopify account, similar to the process described in this [Documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/shopify-graphql/setup.html) page.
4.  Click on **\+ Data Pipeline** to start adding data pipelines to your account.
